The Ultimate Media Player.

iMPlayer is a powerful media player designed for M3U playlists and supported streaming formats, delivering a premium cable-like experience with Live TV, VOD, recording, downloads, and full EPG browsing.

Available on Apple TV, iPhone, iPad, Android phones and tablets, and Android TV.

Apple App StoreHow to Install (Android TV)
Google Play Store
Android TVAndroid Mobile
Direct APK (TV Version)

Android TV (APK) downloader code: 82375

iMPlayer is strictly a media player. It does not provide content, playlists, or IPTV service. Users are expected to load their own legal content and sources.

Key Features

Built to make IPTV playback feel cleaner, faster, and more flexible.

iMPlayer combines live TV workflows, VOD support, downloads, recording, and customizable interface controls into one player designed for everyday use across multiple devices.

01

Cloud Management

Manage your setup more easily across devices with our online dashboard.

Add playlists, modify your settings, hide content directly, create groups of devices or simply manage your family devices in your dashboard.

02

Playback built around real viewing habits

Move between live channels, catch-up, VOD, and guide browsing with a layout designed to feel more like a polished TV platform than a basic playlist loader.

03

Catch-up, VOD, and recording

Use supported playlists with catch-up, browse on-demand content, and access recording or download flows when your source supports them.

04

Full EPG and deep customization

Browse complete program guide data, adjust app behavior, and customize the interface to match the way you actually watch.

F.A.Q

Quick answers before you get started.

Does iMPlayer provide content?

No. iMPlayer is presented as a player only, and users are expected to bring their own playlists and legal media sources.

Can users download outside app stores?

Yes. The page includes the App Store, a Google Play dropdown for mobile and TV, and the official direct APK path.

Where should people go for help?

Check our Official Documentation or use any of the official support channels below for any question, bug reporting and/or suggestion.
